decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered Draft Travel Plan, Transport Statement (10 January 2011), WXPCHIS001-1, E-01, Layout Proposed, P-01, Planning Statement, Received 18 January 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used for an Explore Learning Centre and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in an provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for an Explore Learning Centre shall not be carried on outside the following times: Monday to Friday 10am to 8pm, Saturdays 10am to 6pm and Sundays 10am to 4pm.

Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted for Explore Learning Centre shall not begin until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 6 - Before first occupation of the building, a Travel Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Travel Plan shall: i) Include a commitment to undertake an iTRACE compliant site audit and staff/visitor travel survey to gauge current travel behaviour (standard audit form and survey attached). The survey must be rerun every two years for a total period of 5 years (at years 1, 3 and 5) and if requested in writing, a copy of the survey results shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority.ii) Provide an action plan within three months of occupation setting out (with SMART objectives and targets) how the developer intends to communicate and promote sustainable transport options to staff and students - e.g. provision of bus route information, information about cycle training opportunities, salary sacrifice scheme etc. iii ) Provide a named travel plan coordinator to travelplans@hounslow.gov.uk. This must be current at all times.Such a travel plan shall be undertaken and maintained as approved.
description: Change of use from B1 (business) to D1 (non-residential institution) including construction of a disabled ramp.
